record.evidence: Discussion 中推测 S-G2 靶向药组合可能产生协同效应，但 Results 部分仅测试了 G1+G1 (lapatinib/palbociclib), S-G2+S-G2 (gemcitabine/doxorubicin), G1+S-G2 (lapatinib/gemcitabine, palbociclib/gemcitabine)。虽然测试了 gemcitabine/doxorubicin，但文中称其 'qualitatively agreed' 且未深入探讨其是否达到预期的 'synergistic effect' 机制，且未测试其他 S-G2 药物对。更准确的缺失是：未验证 Discussion 中提出的 'synergistic effect' 假设（即两个 S-G2 药物组合是否真的协同，因为 gemcitabine/doxorubicin 被描述为 'increasingly cytotoxic' 而非明确的 synergy 机制验证，且未测试其他 S-G2 药物对）。*修正*：根据文本，gemcitabine 和 doxorubicin 都是 S-G2 靶向，文中说 'combining the two cytotoxic drugs led to increasingly cytotoxic responses'。Discussion 说 'We speculate that a synergistic effect... could also arise by combining two drugs that target S-G2 phases'。这表明该推测未被实验直接验证为 'synergy'（通常需 Bliss 指数 > 1 等定量指标，文中仅说 'agreement with experimentally measured combination effects' 和 'increasingly cytotoxic'）。因此，'S-G2 药物组合的协同效应定量验证' 是缺失的。

record.evidence: Discussion 中推测 S-G2 靶向药组合可能产生协同效应，但 Results 部分仅测试了 G1+G1 (lapatinib/palbociclib), S-G2+S-G2 (gemcitabine/doxorubicin), G1+S-G2 (lapatinib/gemcitabine, palbociclib/gemcitabine)。虽然测试了 gemcitabine/doxorubicin，但文中称其 'qualitatively agreed' 且未深入探讨其是否达到预期的 'synergistic effect' 机制，且未测试其他 S-G2 药物对。更准确的缺失是：未验证 Discussion 中提出的 'synergistic effect' 假设（即两个 S-G2 药物组合是否真的协同，因为 gemcitabine/doxorubicin 被描述为 'increasingly cytotoxic' 而非明确的 synergy 机制验证，且未测试其他 S-G2 药物对）。*修正*：根据文本，gemcitabine 和 doxorubicin 都是 S-G2 靶向，文中说 'combining the two cytotoxic drugs led to increasingly cytotoxic responses'。Discussion 说 'We speculate that a synergistic effect... could also arise by combining two drugs that target S-G2 phases'。这表明该推测未被实验直接验证为 'synergy'（通常需 Bliss 指数 > 1 等定量指标，文中仅说 'agreement with experimentally measured combination effects' 和 'increasingly cytotoxic'）。因此，'S-G2 药物组合的协同效应定量验证' 是缺失的。

record.item: procedure for deriving n+1 PN equations of motion
record.value: derive n+1 PN evolution equation for P_A^tau, solve functionally to obtain mass-energy relation, calculate Q_A^i to derive momentum-velocity relation, calculate Q_A^{K_l i} and R_A^{K_l ij}, derive n+1 PN deviation field h^{mu nu}, evaluate surface integrals in Equation (111)
record.quote: With the $n$ PN order equations of motion and $h^{\mu \nu}$ in hand, we first derive the $n + 1$ PN evolution equation for $P_A^\tau$ . Then we solve it functionally and obtain the mass-energy relation at $n + 1$ PN order. Next we calculate $Q_A^i$ at $n + 1$ PN order and derive the momentum-velocity relation at $n + 1$ PN order. Then we calculate $Q_A^{K_l i}$ and $R_A^{K_l ij}$ . With the $n + 1$ PN mass-energy relation, the $n + 1$ PN momentum-velocity relation, $Q_A^{K_l i}$ , and $R_A^{K_l ij}$ , we next derive the $n + 1$ PN deviation field $h^{\mu \nu}$ . Finally we evaluate the surface integrals which appear in the right hand side of Equation (111) and obtain the $n + 1$ PN equations of motion.

This is only applicable when the output and part of the evidence are almost identical. - [Partially supported] - The output is supported by the evidence to some extent, but there is major information in the output that is not discussed in the evidence. For example, if an instruction asks about two concepts and the evidence only discusses either of them, it should be considered a [Partially supported]. - [No support / Contradictory] - The output completely ignores evidence, is unrelated to the evidence, or contradicts the evidence. This can also happen if the evidence is irrelevant to the instruction.

record.claim: The Targeted Regularizer is critical for counteracting the URSLA shortcut by disincentivizing the model from prematurely truncating negative responses as a trivial means of satisfying the loss.
record.quote: The second component of the objective is the Targeted Regularizer, which is critical for counteracting the URSLA shortcut. It applies a penalty, scaled by $\lambda$ , to the End-of-Sequence (EOS) probability of any response that is shorter than a dynamically set target (the maximum length in the batch). This mechanism explicitly disincentivizes the model from prematurely truncating negative responses as a trivial means of satisfying the loss.
